description: Default offboarding checklist policy — configurable per tenant

defaultChecklist.title: Notice Period Acknowledgement
defaultChecklist.description: Employee signs acknowledgement of notice period terms

defaultChecklist.title: Knowledge Handover Tasks
defaultChecklist.description: All knowledge handover tasks assigned and completed by employee

defaultChecklist.title: Asset Return (Laptop, Access Cards)
defaultChecklist.description: All company assets returned and logged

defaultChecklist.title: System Access Revocation
defaultChecklist.description: IT confirms all system access revoked

defaultChecklist.title: Final Payroll Confirmation
defaultChecklist.description: Finance confirms final payroll amount including accruals

defaultChecklist.title: ESB Calculation Review and Approval
defaultChecklist.description: HR reviews and approves ESB calculation before final payment

defaultChecklist.title: Reference Letter Issued
defaultChecklist.description: Optional: reference letter prepared and issued to employee

defaultChecklist.title: Exit Interview Completed
defaultChecklist.description: Optional: exit interview conducted and notes recorded
